When orcs raid, the strongest is chosen as the leader, backed up by their siblings and other immediate family. If leadership is contested, candidates vie for control with displays of physical prowess or stirring speeches. **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 16 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11 [Orc Commander](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3132) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 259 **Perception** +8; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Orcish](/Languages.aspx?ID=9) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +8, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +6, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +5 **Str** +4 **Dex** +2 **Con** +1 **Int** -1 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +2 **Items** [Greatclub](/Weapons.aspx?ID=22), [Hide Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=7), [Javelin](/Weapons.aspx?ID=71) (6) --- **AC** 19 **Fort** +7 **Ref** +6 **Will** +7 **HP** 32 **[Ferocity](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=63)**
**[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** greatclub +10 ([Backswing](/Traits.aspx?ID=173), [Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)), **Damage** 1d10+4 bludgeoning **Melee** fist +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)), **Damage** 1d4+4 bludgeoning **Ranged** javelin +8 ([thrown 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)), **Damage** 1d6+4 piercing **Battle Cry** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) Bellowing mightily, the orc commander gives themself and all orc allies within 60 feet a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls until the start of the orc commander's next turn.
